segments.text: Ok so this is the state rendering page for Claude Agent SDK TypeScript on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the panel reads from an agent called researcher, and that agent is never set up.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part wasn't on the page, I had to add it myself, the agent loop.
Moving on to the demo. The progress panel should update while the agent works, but the agent just answers in chat and the panel stays idle.
So basically, the panel wants status and progress fields, but the agent on the page only writes notes, so nothing can move the panel.
So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
